skill.name: nature-paper-to-patent
skill.description: Convert scientific papers, theses, technical reports, source code, figures, or research manuscripts into evidence-grounded Chinese invention patent drafts. Use when an AI agent must extract patentable technical contributions, map every claimed feature to source evidence, preserve core formulas as editable Office Math, generate claim-aligned flowcharts and methodology figures, compare a paper with an existing patent, audit support and consistency, or deliver separate Chinese DOCX files for claims, specification, abstract, and abstract figure.
skill.summary: Evidence-grounded workflow for converting research sources into Chinese invention patent draft packages.
skill.author: Yuan1z0825

content.value_statement: Research teams struggle to turn technical papers into traceable Chinese patent drafts. This skill structures evidence, claims, figures, formulas, and DOCX deliverables for expert review.
actual_capabilities: Routes papers, scanned PDFs, pasted text, and mixed projects through task-specific drafting fragments.
Builds stable source IDs for paper text, equations, figures, code, and supplementary evidence.
Maps each material claim feature to evidence with support status labels.
Creates Chinese claims, specification, abstract, abstract figure, and full review DOCX files.
Renders claim-aligned black-and-white flowcharts as SVG and optional PNG files.
Runs validation checks for claim structure, formula coverage, figure links, and terminology consistency.
limitations: It does not provide patentability, novelty, infringement, ownership, or filing advice.
It cannot recover unreadable formulas or figures without user confirmation.
It depends on accurate source files and page locators from the user.
It requires local Python dependencies for DOCX, formula, and figure generation.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Research Disclosure Package
use_cases.description: Convert a paper and inventor notes into a structured Chinese patent draft for professional review.

use_cases.title: Audit Claim Support
use_cases.description: Check whether each proposed claim feature has explicit or inherent support in the source material.

use_cases.title: Compare Paper and Patent Scope
use_cases.description: Map a paper against an existing patent and separate shared, paper-only, and patent-only features.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Full Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete package from one paper.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the paper in paper/paper.pdf. Create a Chinese invention patent draft with claims, specification, abstract, and abstract figure. Mark missing facts as inventor questions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Claims Only
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused request for claim architecture before full documents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the supplied paper text and inventor notes to draft only the Chinese claim set. Map every material feature to source evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Unclear Scans
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request when OCR or formula quality is limited.
prompt_templates.prompt: The paper is a scanned PDF and some formulas are unclear. Draft supported claim content only and list specific questions for uncertain symbols.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Paper and Patent
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for paper-patent relationship analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the supplied paper with the existing patent. Create a feature-by-feature support table and label paper-only, patent-only, broader, and narrower content.

output_examples.input: A selectable PDF about an image defect detection model with equations and method figures.
output_examples.output: Chinese claims, specification sections, abstract, source IDs, evidence ledger, editable formula plan, flowchart, and review package.

output_examples.input: A scanned PDF where formula symbols are partly unreadable.
output_examples.output: Confirmed technical features are drafted, uncertain symbols become inventor questions, and unsupported material stays outside formal claims.

output_examples.input: A paper and a related patent PDF for comparison.
output_examples.output: A feature comparison separates shared content, paper-only content, patent-only content, broader claims, and narrower claims.

best_practices: Provide complete source files, page locators, inventor notes, and any known publication dates.
Resolve every confirmation question before treating claims as ready for filing review.
Have a qualified Chinese patent professional review all generated documents.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent unsupported technical features.
Do not treat generated output as a legal opinion or filing guarantee.
Do not file documents without inventor confirmation and professional review.

faq.question: Does this skill file a patent application?
faq.answer: No. It creates drafting materials and DOCX files for review by inventors and patent professionals.

faq.question: Can it work with scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, but unclear text and formulas must be confirmed by the user before formal drafting.

faq.question: Does it support formulas?
faq.answer: Yes. It tracks source formulas and prepares them for editable Office Math output in DOCX files.

faq.question: Can it compare a paper with an existing patent?
faq.answer: Yes. It can map features between the paper and patent without assuming ownership or priority.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is the generated draft legally sufficient?
faq.answer: No. The generated package is a drafting aid and needs professional legal review.
